name: Undead Girlfriend Hunter
source:
Step onto a haunted campus in this vampire-versus-zombie romance, where hearts rise from the grave. Meet Lila, a mysterious vampire with a dramatic flair; Mira, a relentless hunter hiding a fragile heart; and Clara, an energetic zombie researcher with a love for adventure. But appearances can be deceiving… Can you find love amid chaos before the undead claim your heart—literally?

Prepare for an unforgettable supernatural university experience.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.vampirevszombie]Google Play[/url]]
